metadata.question: Does the ice coverage of the Great Lakes decrease from February 20, 2021 to March 3, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Collection: Sentinel-2 (high-resolution, available in Feb-Mar 2021) or Landsat 8 - Date: 2021-02-20 and 2021-03-03 - Location: Great Lakes (use a bounding box covering all 5 lakes) - Cloud masking: Critical, as clouds obscure ice. Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 or BQA for Landsat 8. 2. **Masking strategy**: - Mask clouds and cloud shadows using QA60 - Extract NDIS (Normalized Difference Ice Index) or use blue/red bands to detect ice - Alternatively, use simple NDIS: (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR), where ice has high values 3. **Logic to distinguish**: - Valid decrease (A): Feb ice coverage % > Mar ice coverage % - No decrease (B): Feb ice coverage % ≤ Mar ice coverage % - C1: No images found for either date - C2: After cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid ranges ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Great Lakes geometry (bounding box) const greatLakes = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-92, 41, -75, 47]); // 2. Define dates const date1 = '2021-02-20'; const date2 = '2021-03-03'; // 3. Function to detect ice using NDIS (Normalized Difference Ice Index) function calculateIceCoverage(date, label) { let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2') .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(greatLakes) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 50)); const size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`${label} Images Found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { return null; } // Cloud mask using QA60 function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } col = col.map(maskClouds); // Median composite const img = col.median(); // Calculate NDIS: (B3-B11) / (B3+B11) where B3=Green, B11=SWIR const ndis = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDIS'); // Ice typically has NDIS > 0.4 const iceMap = ndis.gte(0.4); // Calculate valid pixels and ice coverage const pixelCount = iceMap.reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: greatLakes, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9} ).get('NDIS').getInfo(); const icePixels = iceMap.reduceRegion( {reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: greatLakes, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9} ).get('NDIS').getInfo(); console.log(`${label} - Valid Pixels: ${pixelCount}, Ice Pixels: ${icePixels}`); if (!pixelCount || pixelCount === 0) { return null; } const iceCoverage = (icePixels / pixelCount) * 100; console.log(`${label} - Ice Coverage: ${iceCoverage.toFixed(2)}%`); return iceCoverage; } // 4. Calculate ice coverage for both dates const coverage1 = calculateIceCoverage(date1, 'Feb 20, 2021'); const coverage2 = calculateIceCoverage(date2, 'Mar 03, 2021'); // 5. Validate and determine answer if (coverage1 === null) { console.log('No valid data for Feb 20, 2021'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (coverage2 === null) { console.log('No valid data for Mar 03, 2021'); console.log('C1'); return; } if (coverage1 === 0 && coverage2 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } const decrease = coverage1 - coverage2; console.log(`Ice Coverage Change: ${decrease.toFixed(2)}%`); if (decrease > 0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
